title: [factory-setup-agent] Setup round 1: repo contains no application, so the sandbox is tier `static`
body:
Setup phase 2, round 1. The candidate design is written to the `setup-round-1` artifact (`manifest.json`, `context/*.md`, `research-domains.txt`). This issue records what the episode found, because the finding is unusual enough to be worth a human's attention before the setup PR is merged.

## The finding

**There is no application in this repository.** Despite the name, it is not a polyglot monorepo — it is the factory scaffolding and nothing else.

The tracked tree on `main` is 56 files:

- `README.md` — two lines
- `.factory/` — `bin/` (the `bsf` launcher, `VERSION`, `runner.tgz`), `definition/`, `guardrails/`
- `.github/workflows/` — 29 `factory-*` orchestration workflows and compiled role agents

Searched for and did not find, anywhere in the tree: `package.json`, `pyproject.toml`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `Gemfile`, `*.csproj`, `pom.xml`, `build.gradle*`, `Makefile`, `Taskfile*`, `composer.json`, `mix.exs`, `deno.json`, `requirements*.txt`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose*`/`compose.y*ml`, `.devcontainer/`. No source file in any language. The only directories are `.factory/` and `.github/workflows/`.

I ruled out a stale or sparse checkout rather than assuming: the four branches are `main`, `factory/bootstrap`, `upgrade-e29d8e0` and `upgrade-factory`, and the GitHub API's root listing for `main` returns exactly `.factory`, `.github`, `README.md` — identical to the local checkout. `factory/bootstrap` is the factory's own data ref. The single commit on `main` is `72d8322 Upgrade the factory to e29d8e0 (#4)`.

## What the manifest claims

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `tier` | `static` |
| `commands.install/build/run/test/seed` | all `null` |
| `app_url` | `null` |
| `env`, `services`, `egress`, `stubs` | all empty |

`null` is the schema's way of saying "this repo has none", which is the accurate encoding here. No stubs were written: there is no client code, so there is no third party to stand in for.

Verified before submitting:

```
$ .factory/bin/bsf sandbox check --file .../manifest.json
valid sandbox manifest, tier static

$ .factory/bin/bsf sandbox trial --candidate .../manifest.json --out .../trial.json
reached static, as claimed
met=true
```

## A note on the tier

`build_and_test` was technically reachable. `reachedTier` in the runner only asks whether a step ran and exited zero, not whether it did anything, so a do-nothing `install` command would have measured one tier higher and the trial would have agreed. I did not do that. There is nothing to install, and a manifest that says otherwise would mislead every role that reads it afterwards.

## What this costs

Recorded in full under `capabilities.not_exercised`. In short, the factory can verify nothing here beyond reading files:

- no install, build, test or app start;
- **no static gate either** — no linter, formatter or type checker is configured, and `.factory/guardrails/baselines.json` has an empty `rules` map;
- no coverage — `coverage.json` is at bootstrap defaults (`high_pct: 0`, `floor_pct: 0`) and `factory.yaml` sets `existing_ci.test_check: null`.

## What should happen next

The merged sandbox goes stale the moment real code arrives — it declares no command for it. The first change that adds a package manifest should trigger an inadequacy report (`bsf sandbox report`) so an amendment episode rebuilds the sandbox around the stack that actually lands. Editing `.factory/sandbox/manifest.json` by hand, or treating a change as verified when only file reads happened, is the failure mode to watch for.

If this fixture was meant to arrive with application code in it, that code is missing and the empty manifest is a symptom rather than the answer — worth checking before the setup PR merges.

## Context files

Written from what is in the repo, with absences stated rather than filled in:

- **`feature-map.md`** — no feature folders; documents the four scaffolding directories and what each owns. Records that no feature/shared root convention exists yet, so the first change to add code also picks them.
- **`runbook.md`** — every command empty, with the full list of what was searched for. The stateful-commands table is real: `bsf practice add` and `bsf sandbox report` both write to the factory data ref and dispatch workflows.
- **`fundamentals.md`** — patterns read off the factory scaffolding (compiled `.md` → `.lock.yml` agents, the trusted-runner-from-default-branch block, `persist-credentials: false`, safe-outputs for writes). Deliberate exceptions include `runner.tgz` being packed so no linter in this repo reads it, and the verbatim-vendored gh-aw hashing helpers.
- **`history.md`** — tables empty. One commit means no corrections to mine; that is the finding, not a gap in the search.
- **`research-domains.txt`** — three hosts: `docs.github.com`, `githubnext.github.io`, `json-schema.org`. No application stack means no framework docs to add.
